# 1. データ読み込み
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# オブジェクトクリア
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

# DHSデータのルートフォルダを指定
gdrive_dir <- "/Users/snakada/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-snakada@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp/マイドライブ/Peru_work/Peru_endes/spss"

# 結果保存先
save_path <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output")

# 必要な関数読み込み
source("_tool_safe_join.R")
source("_tool_labels.R")  # 安全なラベル管理

# ステップ1: 元データの読み込み
df_org <- readRDS(
    file.path(gdrive_dir, "output","all_data_merged_dummy.rds")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(v021) & !is.na(v022) & !is.na(sampling_weight_trimmed)) %>%
  strip_all_labels() # ラベルを一時的に剥がす


# 先に year を numeric に
df_org <- df_org %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))


df_org <- df_org %>%
  # treatment_group 1(2012年に介入を受けたグループ)を除外
  filter(treatment_group != 1) %>%
  
  mutate(
    treat2 = case_when(
      treatment_group == 0 ~ 0,
      treatment_group == 2 ~ 1,
      .default = NA_real_
    ),
    post = case_when(
        year < 2012 ~ 0,
        year >= 2012 ~ 1,
        .default = NA_real_
    )
  )

# コントロール変数の定義
cov <- c(
  "rc_edu_acceptable",
  "dm_weath_index",
  "dm_rural__Yes",
  "dm_livestock_unit",
  "dm_ag_land_ha",
  "dm_altitude_high"
)

# mediatorの定義
mediators <- c(
  "rh_anc_4vs__Yes",
  "rh_del_pvskill__Skilled_provider",
  "nt_wm_ht__Yes",
  "nt_wm_thin__Yes",
  "dm_house_crowding3",
  "juntos_participation"
)

# make_mediator_formula関数の定義
make_mediator_formula = function(outcome_var, control = cov){
  tmp <- paste(
    c("treat2", 
      "post", 
      "treat2:post",
      cov),
    collapse = " + "
  )
  return(as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", tmp)))
}
  
# -----------------------------------------
# ここから開始⬇️

df_did_result <- data_frame()

for (mediator in mediators) {
  # DID推定のための式を作成
  formula <- make_mediator_formula(mediator)

  # DID推定の実行
  did_func <- lm(formula, data = df_org)
  
  # 結果の抽出
  res <- summary(did_func)
  did_est <- res$coefficients["treat2:post", "Estimate"]
  did_se  <- res$coefficients["treat2:post", "Std. Error"]
  did_p   <- res$coefficients["treat2:post", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  did_ci_lower <- did_est - 1.96 * did_se
  did_ci_upper <- did_est + 1.96 * did_se
  
  tmp_df <- data_frame(
    mediator_var = mediator,
    did_est = did_est,
    did_se  = did_se,
    did_p   = did_p,
  )
  df_did_result <- rbind(df_did_result, tmp_df)
}

```
